audience.psychographics: Ceramic enthusiasts, collectors, weekend wanderers and curious beginners touring 26 studios and 35 ceramicists across the Byron, Lismore and Ballina shires, with free talks and demos, ticketed hands-on workshops and gallery openings.

add_sources.note: @northcoastceramics (13 Jul 2026) interactive Mud Trail map post: 'Proudly presented by First National Byron'. Facebook page and Locale Magazine also say the 2026 trail is presented by First National.
'A huge thank you to Fired Up Kilns for supporting the North Coast Mud Trail - returning this year as our Workshop Partner!' (posted Jun to Aug 2026).
'The major sponsors of the trail this year are Mud Australia' (2022, Google snippet).
Mud Trail page has a 'With Gratitude to Our 2025 Mud Trail Sponsors' block with about 22 logos; no names or alt text in the crawl.

North Coast Ceramics is 'the peak body for ceramics in the Northern Rivers', a $50 a year membership body that runs the Mud Trail, two markets and the Surface Award; Facebook handle northcoastceramicsinc.
Site email info@northcoastceramics.com; no separate sponsorship page.
2026 page: 'ceramic enthusiasts, collectors, weekend wanderers and curious beginners'; IG: 26 studios, 35 ceramicists, free talks and demos.
Presenting credit on the trail map (First National Byron) and a named Workshop Partner (Fired Up Kilns).
